rationale: Archive NextDecade Corporation from the direct-infrastructure PortCo list and retract the Mubadala period because the 2019 exposure is common stock in a Nasdaq-listed parent. Mubadala's qualifying private infrastructure ownership is already represented once on the separate Rio Grande LNG company from the July 12, 2023 Phase 1 closing.

evidence.purpose: SEC ownership filing proving the 2019 Mubadala exposure was listed NextDecade common stock rather than private project equity.
Phase 1 LLC agreement supporting Mubadala's qualifying private Rio Grande LNG interest through MIC at the July 12, 2023 project closing.
Latest proxy evidence confirming the continuing listed-parent shareholding and its public-security character.

companyFieldUpdates.description: NextDecade Corporation is a Nasdaq-listed LNG-development company and the corporate sponsor of Rio Grande LNG. Mubadala's 2019 investment was common stock in this listed parent and is therefore outside the direct-infrastructure PortCo census. Mubadala's qualifying private project-company investment began at the Rio Grande LNG Phase 1 closing on July 12, 2023 and is represented on the separate Rio Grande LNG canonical company, including later Train 4 and Train 5 follow-ons.
